top5.title: A software update reportedly caused flights to stop across the United States
top5.description: An update to L3Harris’s private network reportedly caused communications used by U.S. air traffic control to fail. The FAA lifted the flight stoppage after more than four hours, but delays are expected to continue for several days.
top5.why: A software update that halted U.S. air traffic control communications for more than four hours exposes the operational and systemic risks of concentrated critical infrastructure.

top5.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system
top5.description: A Federal Reserve survey finds that artificial intelligence risks are considered the biggest threat to the financial system.
top5.why: The Federal Reserve identifying AI as the biggest threat to financial stability signals that AI risk is moving from a technology issue into a core regulatory and markets concern.

top5.title: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly oversubscribed sixfold
top5.description: Anthropic’s IPO is reportedly oversubscribed sixfold and could become the largest in history.
top5.why: An oversubscribed Anthropic IPO could become the largest ever, demonstrating extraordinary investor demand for leading AI companies and potentially resetting private and public-market valuations.

top5.title: Solar power and batteries are reportedly the cheapest option for AI data centers
top5.description: A study estimates that on-site solar power paired with batteries is becoming the cheapest option for AI data centers in 85% of U.S. regions. It attributes this advantage to faster construction, which allows computing capacity to be added more quickly.
top5.why: On-site solar paired with batteries could become the cheapest and fastest way to power AI data centers across most U.S. regions, reshaping infrastructure investment and deployment timelines.

top5.title: Starship reaches orbit despite its booster exploding
top5.description: The Starship spacecraft reached orbit on its 15th test flight and deployed 26 Starlink satellites. The Super Heavy booster failed during its return and exploded in the Gulf of Mexico.
top5.why: Starship reaching orbit and deploying 26 Starlink satellites marks a major step toward SpaceX’s reusable heavy-lift and satellite-network ambitions despite the booster failure.
